Closes #2196. Refs #2113.

## What this adds

Phase 1 of the Agent Service component: the types and Protocols of the signature-level contracts, with no implementation, and the in-memory stand-ins that both development groups code against.

| Contract | Code |
| --- | --- |
| Backend inbound (AS-M1) | `server/agent_service/backend/inbound.py` |
| HostAPI to Session Store ports (AS-M2) | `server/agent_service/session_store/host_ports.py` |
| Harness channel (AS-M3) | `server/agent_service/harness/contract.py` |
| Mobile Gateway proxy (AS-C2, AS-C3) and provider gateway proxies (AS-C4, AS-C5) | `server/agent_service/proxy.py` |
| Session Manager to Backend ports | `server/agent_service/manager_backend_owner_contract.py`, a transcription of the merged contract |
| Shared value types `RunSelection`, `AnswerContent`, selection encoder | `server/agent_service/run_contracts.py` |

Stand-ins for every Protocol are in `tests/server/agent_service/standins/` (Store, Session Manager, Backend, both channel ends, four proxies). They keep the identity and idempotency rules of each contract and take injected faults (`unknown`, `drop_ack`).

All production code is new files. No deployed entry changes.

## Where code and contract differ, and what was changed

- **`RunSelection` and `AnswerContent` are in `run_contracts.py`, not `contracts.py`.** `RunSelection` holds Registry's `ImplementationRef`; `registry/proxy.py` imports `session_store/proxy.py`, which imports `contracts.py`, so `contracts.py` cannot import Registry. The Backend inbound and Harness channel contract pages are amended in this PR to name the new module. No shape, encoding or rule changed; the encoding vector still gives `7b98f01e…2b73`.
- Nothing else differs. A unit test compares all six signature blocks with the code.

## For the Session Store and Session Manager owner (@huben0423-hw), interface part

1. `manager_backend_owner_contract.py` is transcribed from your merged contract and its ownership row names the Session Manager owner. Take it over or replace it; the signature test keeps both sides equal. The block's import of `delivery_owner_contract.TaskRef` is left out because that module does not exist yet and no signature uses it.
2. `HostStorePorts` (eight methods) and `PublicationStorePorts` are defined once, in `session_store/host_ports.py`. Your owner ports contract also shows a six-method `HostStorePorts` in `store_owner_contract.py`. Please import the one from `host_ports.py`, or say which page governs.
3. `tests/architecture/test_a02_enrollment.py` lists the Store files; this PR adds `host_ports.py` to that list and nothing else in your area.
4. Stand-ins import as `agent_service.standins.<module>` with `tests/server` on the path.

本 PR 落实 Session Store Phase 2 的认领与 authority 工作包：`claim_run`、`read_claim`，以及与认领一致的只读 `check_claim`；`enter_run` 按 host-store 契约现文实现，不自行补语义。不包含 #2203/#2204 的控制、终态、补充绑定端口。

叠在 [#2221](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2221) 之上（base 为 `feat/2197-session-store`）。#2221 合入联调分支后，再把本 PR 的 base 改到 `component/agent-service`。不要合入 `main`。

## 落点说明

新代码仍在过渡目录 `temp/agent-service-session-store/`（包名 `dm_session_store_owner`），没有向现有 `server/agent_service/session_store/` 增加生产文件。UT 在 `tests/server/agent_service/test_store_claim_authority.py`，复用 foundation 夹具。新入口仍在配置开关 `DIGITALMATE_AGENT_SERVICE_STORE_OWNER_PORTS` 后面，默认关闭，未改 `server.agent_service.host` 或现网 `serve` 入口。未平行定义 #2196 的共用类型（`RunClaim` / `RunAuthority` 等）；本包对外使用 Store 签发的 `GrantedClaim` / `GrantedAuthority`，#2196 落地后再改接到共用类型。`ownership.json` 已声明对 `agent-service-contracts` 的依赖（使用已有的 `AdmittedRunIdentity`、`Revision`）。

## 接口说明

`SessionStoreClaimPorts`（`open_claim_ports`，与内核一样受功能开关约束）：

- `claim_run(request: ClaimRunRequest) -> ClaimCommitted | StoreRefused | StoreUnknown`
  - `ClaimRunRequest(operation_id, run, expected_revision, expected_claim=NoLiveClaim|SupersedeClaim, start_basis=FirstStart|ResumeFrom)`
  - 同键重试返回原回执；变更意图返回 `StoreRefused(CONFLICT)`；并发认领只提交一个合法值（其余 `STALE` 或 `CONFLICT`）
  - 预期修订不匹配为 `STALE`；已有终态或主体被禁用为 `DENIED`；`ResumeFrom` 缺少材料为 `INCOMPATIBLE`
- `read_claim(query: ClaimQuery) -> 上述观察 | StoreAbsent`
  - 按原请求读取已提交结果；缺席不授予执行权
- `check_claim(*, claim) -> ClaimCheck`
  - 只读、读取时刻事实，不保留进入权
  - `CURRENT`：该认领是当前执行权且 Run 无终态（启动前预检查，不是持久进入许可）
  - 已提交 Stop：`FENCED`；已有终态：`TERMINAL`；无法观察：`UNKNOWN`
- `enter_run(*, claim, selection_sha256) -> EnterStatus`
  - 同一事务内核对该认领仍是当前执行权、无已提交 Stop、选集摘要与受理时记录一致，然后记录进入
  - `ENTERED`：本次记录了进入；同一认领再调为 `ALREADY_ENTERED`
  - 进程重启后仍为 `ALREADY_ENTERED`，但 `enter_attempt_live` 为假（不得按本进程未知重试去发 H1）
  - `SELECTION_MISMATCH` / `FENCED` / `TERMINAL` / `UNKNOWN` 按契约现文

Host 侧异步包装：`check_claim_async`、`enter_run_async`（同进程内转到上述同步实现）。为让 `check_claim` / `enter_run` 能观察到 Stop 与终态，测试夹具提供内部 `mark_stop` / `mark_terminal` / `set_selection_digest`，不是 #2203 端口。

## 测试

命令（工作目录为仓库根，解释器 Python 3.13.5，Asia/Shanghai）：

```sh
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service -p 'test_*.py' -v
python3 -m coverage run --source=temp/agent-service-session-store/src/dm_session_store_owner -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service -p 'test_*.py'
python3 -m coverage report -m
python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --root . --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --format json
```

结果：

- UT：40 tests, OK（PASS）（foundation 18 + 本工作包 22）
- 本工作包相关生产模块行覆盖率：98%（530/541，大于 90%）；其中新增 `claims.py` 96%、`observations.py` 100%，foundation 模块仍为 100%（PASS）
- 架构扫描：本 feature 无 findings，exit 0（PASS）
- Phase 3 组件内 ST：按 #2113 在组件分支联验，本 PR 不作为合入阻塞（NOT_RUN）

2228.body:
Closes #2223. Refs #2113.

## What this adds

- `server/agent_service/registry/catalog.py`: `CatalogSnapshot(revision, entries)` and `CATALOG_REVISION = 1` (design review AS-M7). Entries are sorted, so two snapshots of the same registrations are equal.
- `RegistryProxy.catalog_snapshot()`: the only change to `registry/proxy.py`. No existing behaviour, signature, error or binding codec changes.
- `server/agent_service/harness/registration.py`: `register_harness(registry, descriptor)` registers a `HarnessDescriptor` under its exact `core` reference; `harness_descriptor(provider, reference)` returns the descriptor behind a resolved `core` provider (`PreparedProfile.core`) and refuses anything else with `MissingDependency`.

## Choices the design does not fix

- **The descriptor helpers are on the Harness side, not in Registry.** The Harness contract imports Registry's `ImplementationRef`; Registry importing the Harness contract is a component cycle that the architecture scanner refuses. `catalog.py` imports neither.
- **A provider registered the earlier way (a constructed object) still registers and resolves exactly as before.** Only `harness_descriptor` refuses it, because it cannot be started as a process. Existing callers are unchanged.
- **Descriptor identity** is the canonical JSON of its nonsecret fields, so a changed launch command under the same version is detected as drift by `resolve`.

2235.author: huben0423-hw
2235.body:
Closes #2202
Refs #2197
Refs #2113

本 PR 落实 Session Store Phase 2 的认领与 authority 工作包：`claim_run`、`read_claim`，以及与认领一致的只读 `check_claim`；`enter_run` 按 host-store 契约现文实现，不自行补语义。不包含 #2203/#2204 的控制、终态、补充绑定端口。

本包已变基到当前联调分支 `component/agent-service` @ `33893b063d67881d924efa2aa8a1e7cef390a00f`（Merge pull request #2240，Backend；2026-11-21 01:52:14 +0800）。该 tip 是此前要求的 #2239（HostAPI）`b1dbe0dfcad406651671a754da4e47d1b8e5d029` 的后代；强制抓取后发现 tip 已从 `b1dbe0dfcad` 前移，因此按要求叠到新 tip。GitHub 对 `component/agent-service` 的 diff 只包含本工作包的增量。不要合入 `main`。

本 PR 取代仍落在 `temp/` 的旧实现 [#2226](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/2226)（已关闭），并取代 fork 仓内的同名草案 [huben0423-hw/DigitalMate#19](https://github.com/huben0423-hw/DigitalMate/pull/19)。相对旧实现，本包保留并继续覆盖 #2226 评审中的 must-fix：

- F1：认领世代写入改为在内核锁内对新鲜文档做变更；同一内核上的两个 port 实例不能在同一修订同时返回 `ClaimCommitted`
- F2：Run 已提交 Stop 后，`claim_run` 拒绝新世代（`DENIED`），避免授予一个永远被 `check_claim` / `enter_run` 判为 `FENCED` 的认领
- F3：`ResumeFrom` 只接受已提交的恢复材料；仅暂存的材料视为 `INCOMPATIBLE`，因为 `restart()` 会丢掉 staged 状态

## 本次 must-fix（#2235 F1 / F2）

先前实现用 CAS 前拍下的整份 run-state 再写回，且 `_save_state` 丢掉了 `expected`，因此并发的 Stop / 终态 / 进入记录可能被覆盖，刚被 fence 的认领也可能被陈旧写回复活。本包已改为：

- 删除 `_save_state` 以及对整份快照的 `compare_and_set` 写回
- 认领授予、进入、Stop / 终态标记都通过内核 `mutate_committed`，在同一把文档锁下读取新鲜文档再变更
- 进入路径在变更函数内重新校验当前认领 / Stop / 终态 / 选集；若认领已被取代，返回 `FENCED`，不把旧的 live 认领写回去
- 未知字段（控制侧的问题、Stop 证据等）由共享的 `normalize_run_state` 原样保留

回归用例：

- `test_supersede_does_not_erase_a_concurrent_stop`
- `test_supersede_preserves_a_concurrent_enter`
- `test_stale_enter_does_not_revive_a_superseded_claim`（含重启后下一世代从 revision 2 起算）
- `test_claim_writers_preserve_unknown_run_state_fields`
- `test_mutate_committed_uses_a_fresh_document_and_can_abort`

F3 / F4 / F5 仍是建议项，本包未扩大范围。

库存登记按并集解决（自动合并后已核对）：保留本包 session-store owner-port 的认领/观察组件行、`AGENT_SERVICE_COMPONENT_FILES` 与 `test_a02_enrollment` 精确文件集中的新增项，同时保留已合入的 #2231（Harness framing/channel）、#2233（component settings）、#2239（HostAPI `backend/host_api/endpoint.py` 与 `hooks.py`，以及更新后的 host-api 组件行）和 #2240（Backend budget / ports / run_coordinator / interaction / final / service / host_binding）的登记，没有丢掉任何一侧。内核公开符号补登记了 `MutateAborted` 与 `normalize_run_state`。

## 本包独有工作

相对 `component/agent-service` @ `33893b063d6`，本包新增：

- `server/agent_service/session_store/claims.py`、`observations.py`
- 内核/幂等辅助：`put_committed`、`commit_identified`、`consume_unknown`、`take_lost_ack`、`mutate_committed`、`normalize_run_state`；并为状态写入加上内核锁
- `session_store/__init__.py` 对认领端口的惰性再导出
- UT：`tests/server/agent_service/test_store_claim_authority.py`，以及夹具中的 `claim_ports` / `restart_ports`
- 库存与组件登记：`session-store-owner-claims`、`session-store-owner-observations`；`AGENT_SERVICE_COMPONENT_FILES` 与 `test_a02_enrollment` 同步收录新文件

未改现有 legacy 文件（`proxy.py`、`accounting.py`、`context.py`、`context_schema.py`、`hosted_schema.py`、`schema.py`、`legacy_admission.py`、`legacy_receipts.py`），未改 `host.py` / `serve`，未改 `host_ports.py` 的 Protocol 签名。未翻转目录行 `session-store`（仍为 planned/unchecked）。

## 落点与开关

新生产代码直接进入 `server/agent_service/session_store/`（新文件，不把 legacy 当过渡层）。UT 在 `tests/server/agent_service/`。新入口仍在配置开关 `DIGITALMATE_AGENT_SERVICE_STORE_OWNER_PORTS` 后面，默认关闭；`open_claim_ports` / `open_owner_kernel` 在开关关闭时返回 `None`。

## 类型约定

认领与 authority 记录使用 Phase 1 已落地类型：从 `server.agent_service.manager_backend_owner_contract` 导入 `RunClaim`、`RunAuthority`、`ClaimRef`；从 `server.agent_service.session_store.host_ports` 导入 `ClaimCheck`、`EnterStatus`；从 `server.agent_service.contracts` 导入 `AdmittedRunIdentity`、`Revision`。没有平行定义、也没有再发明 `GrantedClaim` / `GrantedAuthority`。

`ClaimRunRequest`、`ClaimCommitted`、`ClaimQuery`、`NoLiveClaim`、`SupersedeClaim`、`FirstStart`、`ResumeFrom`，以及 `StoreRefusal` / `StoreUncertainty` / `StoreRefused` / `StoreUnknown` / `StoreAbsent` 目前不在 Python 树的共用合约中，本包提供字段兼容的临时 Store 本地替身，不是 #2196 的第二份定义。

## 接口说明

`SessionStoreClaimPorts`（`open_claim_ports`，与内核一样受功能开关约束）：

- `claim_run(request: ClaimRunRequest) -> ClaimCommitted | StoreRefused | StoreUnknown`
  - `ClaimRunRequest(operation_id, run, expected_revision, expected_claim=NoLiveClaim|SupersedeClaim, start_basis=FirstStart|ResumeFrom)`
  - 同键重试返回原回执；变更意图返回 `StoreRefused(CONFLICT)`；并发认领（含同一内核上的两个 port）只提交一个合法值（其余 `STALE` 或 `CONFLICT`）
  - 预期修订不匹配为 `STALE`；已有终态、已提交 Stop、或主体被禁用为 `DENIED`；`ResumeFrom` 缺少已提交材料为 `INCOMPATIBLE`
- `read_claim(query: ClaimQuery) -> 上述观察 | StoreAbsent`
  - 按原请求读取已提交结果；缺席不授予执行权
- `check_claim(*, claim: RunClaim) -> ClaimCheck`
  - 只读、读取时刻事实，不保留进入权
  - `CURRENT`：该认领是当前执行权且 Run 无终态
  - 已提交 Stop：`FENCED`；已有终态：`TERMINAL`；无法观察：`UNKNOWN`
- `enter_run(*, claim: RunClaim, selection_sha256) -> EnterStatus`
  - 同一事务内核对该认领仍是当前执行权、无已提交 Stop、选集摘要与受理时记录一致，然后记录进入
  - `ENTERED`：本次记录了进入；同一认领再调为 `ALREADY_ENTERED`
  - 进程重启后仍为 `ALREADY_ENTERED`，但 `enter_attempt_live` 为假（不得按本进程未知重试去发 H1）
  - `SELECTION_MISMATCH` / `FENCED` / `TERMINAL` / `UNKNOWN` 按契约现文

Host 侧异步包装：`check_claim_async`、`enter_run_async`（同进程内转到上述同步实现）。为让 `check_claim` / `enter_run` 能观察到 Stop 与终态，测试夹具提供内部 `mark_stop` / `mark_terminal` / `set_selection_digest`，不是 #2203 端口。

## 测试

命令（工作目录为仓库根，解释器 Python 3.13，Asia/Shanghai；覆盖率在虚拟环境中运行）：

```sh
PYTHONPATH=.:temp/beebou/src python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service -t tests/server -p 'test_*.py'
<venv>/bin/python -m coverage run --source=server/agent_service/session_store -m unittest tests.server.agent_service.test_store_claim_authority tests.server.agent_service.test_store_foundation
<venv>/bin/python -m coverage report -m --include='server/agent_service/session_store/claims.py,server/agent_service/session_store/observations.py,server/agent_service/session_store/kernel.py'
python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --root . --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --format json
PYTHONPATH=tests/architecture python3 -B -m unittest tests.architecture.test_a02_enrollment.StoreEnrollmentTests.test_exact_checked_files_and_real_public_owner_are_clean
```

结果（在 `33893b063d6` 上复测）：

- UT：404 tests, OK（PASS）。其中认领 + foundation 48 个（含先前 F1–F3 与本次并发 Stop / 进入 / 陈旧写回回归）。既有 foundation、HostAPI、settings 与 Backend 测试均保持通过。
- 新增/改动的 owner-port 模块行覆盖率大于 90%：`claims.py` 96%、`observations.py` 100%、`kernel.py` 99%。
- 架构扫描：0 findings，exit 0（PASS）
- `test_a02_enrollment` 精确文件集：PASS
- 未提交 `.coverage`

请勿自行合入。

2236.body:
Closes #2203
Refs #2197
Refs #2113

本 PR 落实 Session Store Phase 2 的控制与终态工作包：`record_control`、`read_control`、`commit_terminal`、`read_terminal`。为校验 `RunAnswer`，同期实现 Host 侧 `register_question`（契约现文；本包不暴露 `PublicationStorePorts`，那是 #2208）。不包含 #2204 的 `bind_task_supplement`，也不包含 #2205/#2206/#2207 端口。

本包叠在 #2235 / #2202（认领与 authority，fork 分支 `huben0423-hw:feat/2202-claim-authority`）之上，并已变基到当前联调分支 `component/agent-service` @ `33893b063d67881d924efa2aa8a1e7cef390a00f`（Merge pull request #2240，Backend；该 tip 是 #2239 HostAPI `b1dbe0dfcad406651671a754da4e47d1b8e5d029` 的后代。强制抓取后 tip 已从 `b1dbe0dfcad` 前移，因此按要求叠到新 tip）。

因为上游仓库不能用 fork 分支做 base，也不能把本功能分支推到 `openJiuwen-ai`，本 PR 的 base 同样是 `component/agent-service`。因此在 #2235 合入之前，本 PR 的 diff 会包含 #2202 的认领实现。本包独有工作是 `control.py`、对应 UT / 夹具，控制端口的库存与 enrollment 行，以及终态 CAS / 共享 run-state schema 修复。#2235 合入后，diff 会收缩到上述独有文件。不要合入 `main`。

本 PR 取代 fork 仓内的草案 [huben0423-hw/DigitalMate#20](https://github.com/huben0423-hw/DigitalMate/pull/20)。

## 本次 must-fix（#2236 F1 / F2 / F3）

- F1：`commit_terminal` 改为在内核 `transact` 下使用 CAS；终态事实与 `Publication` 在同一次内核事务中落地。两个 port 并发提交时，只有一个得到 `TerminalCommitted`，另一个为 `STALE`，并且只有一条 TERMINAL publication。
- F2：`SuccessCandidate.turn.identity` 必须与 `request.claim.run` 为同一 Run；跨 Run 候选拒绝为 `StoreRefused(INCOMPATIBLE)`。
- F3：认领侧与控制侧共用 `normalize_run_state`，写入时保留对方字段。认领侧写回不再丢掉 `current_question` / `stop_evidence_ref` 等控制字段；控制侧写回不再丢掉认领字段。`ALREADY_REGISTERED` 若文档里缺 `current_question` 会把它恢复，使后续 `RunAnswer` 仍可作答。

回归用例：

- `test_two_ports_commit_only_one_terminal_and_one_publication`
- `test_success_candidate_from_another_run_is_refused`
- `test_question_survives_supersede_and_can_be_answered`
- `test_stop_evidence_survives_a_claim_side_write`

为通过 AR01，`transact` 不再经由访问私有字段的辅助对象，而是在可重入锁下把内核自身交给回调。

## 本次 must-fix（#2236 F8）

`ALREADY_REGISTERED` 的 F3 恢复路径原先只要 `current_question` 指针与本次请求不一致就会写回，没有比较 `interaction_generation`。因此：登记 generation 1 → 同一 interaction 登记 generation 2 → 再重放 generation 1（内容相同）会返回 `ALREADY_REGISTERED`，并把 `current_question["revision"]` 回滚到 1，随后 `expected_question_revision=Revision(1)` 的 `RunAnswer` 会被接受。重复或排队的旧 H1 即可触发，不需要并发。

本包已改为：仅当指针缺失，或 `current_question["revision"] <= question.interaction_generation` 时才恢复指针；若本次是更旧的 generation，仍返回 `ALREADY_REGISTERED`，但不写状态。

回归用例：`test_replayed_older_question_does_not_roll_back_current_revision`（登记 gen 1 → gen 2 → 重放 gen 1；当前修订保持为 2，revision-1 的作答为 `STALE`）。

F4–F7 与 F9 仍是建议项，本包未扩大范围。

库存登记按并集解决（自动合并后已核对）：保留 session-store owner-port（含 #2202 的认领/观察与本包的 control）登记，同时保留已合入的 #2231（Harness）、#2233（settings）、#2239（HostAPI `backend/host_api/` 与 host-api 组件行）和 #2240（Backend 七个模块行）的登记，没有丢掉任何一侧。

## 本包独有工作

相对 #2235，本包新增：

- `server/agent_service/session_store/control.py`
- 内核 `transact`，供终态与 publication 一次提交
- UT：`tests/server/agent_service/test_store_control_terminal.py`，以及夹具中的 `control_ports` / `restart_control_ports`
- 库存与组件登记：`session-store-owner-control`；`AGENT_SERVICE_COMPONENT_FILES` 与 `test_a02_enrollment` 同步收录 `control.py`

未改现有 legacy 文件，未改 `host.py` / `serve`，未改 `host_ports.py` 的 Protocol 签名。未翻转目录行 `session-store`（仍为 planned/unchecked）。#2202 的测试辅助 `mark_stop` / `mark_terminal` 仍可用；真实 `record_control(RunStop)` 与 `commit_terminal` 写入同一份 run-state，因此 `check_claim` / `enter_run` 能观察到 `FENCED` / `TERMINAL`。已提交 Stop 后新认领按 #2202 F2 为 `DENIED`。

## 落点与开关

新生产代码直接进入 `server/agent_service/session_store/`。UT 在 `tests/server/agent_service/`。新入口仍在配置开关 `DIGITALMATE_AGENT_SERVICE_STORE_OWNER_PORTS` 后面，默认关闭；`open_control_ports` 在开关关闭时返回 `None`。

## 类型约定

终态与问题/发布记录使用 Phase 1 已落地类型：从 `server.agent_service.manager_backend_owner_contract` 导入 `TerminalRequest`、`TerminalCommitted`、`SuccessCandidate`、`FailedCandidate`、`StoppedCandidate`、`RunClaim`、`OperationId` 及相关 NewType；从 `server.agent_service.session_store.host_ports` 导入 `QuestionRecord`、`QuestionRegisterStatus`、`Publication`、`PublicationKind`；成功候选的 `turn` 使用 `session_store.context.TurnCommit`。没有平行定义这些类型。

`ControlWrite`、`TaskSupplement`、`RunAnswer`、`RunStop`、`TaskSupplementRecorded`、`RunControlRecorded`、`ControlQuery`、`TerminalReceiptQuery`，以及 `DeliveryKey` / `TaskRef` / `InputRef` 目前不在 Python 树的共用合约中，本包提供字段兼容的临时 Store 本地替身，不是 #2196 的第二份定义。`TaskSupplement.content` 会随回执持久化，供后续 #2206 读取同一文本。

## 接口说明

`SessionStoreControlPorts`（`open_control_ports`，受同一功能开关约束）：

- `record_control(request: ControlWrite) -> TaskSupplementRecorded | RunControlRecorded | StoreRefused | StoreUnknown`
  - `ControlWrite` 命令：`TaskSupplement`（可在 Run 之前记录回执，不是 applied/permit/消费）、`RunAnswer`、`RunStop`
  - 同键重试返回原回执；变更意图为 `CONFLICT`；回执本身不是应用或放行
  - `RunAnswer` 要求当前认领、已注册且版本匹配的问题；否则 `STALE`
  - `RunStop` 写入共享 run-state；之后 `check_claim` 为 `FENCED`，新的 Answer / question 为 `STALE` / `STALE`
- `read_control(query: ControlQuery) -> 上述观察 | StoreAbsent`：缺席不是应用或拒绝
- `commit_terminal(request: TerminalRequest) -> TerminalCommitted | StoreRefused | StoreUnknown`
  - 支持全部三种候选：`SuccessCandidate`、`FailedCandidate`、`StoppedCandidate`
  - 缺少 effect / consumption / Stop 证据时返回 `StoreUnknown(EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE)`，不写入持久回执，不伪造已应用回执；补齐证据后同一操作键可重试提交
  - 每个 Run 只能有一个终态；同事务写入内部 `Publication` 义务，重放返回同一 `publication_id`
  - `SuccessCandidate` 必须属于同一 Run，否则 `INCOMPATIBLE`
  - 提交后 `check_claim` 为 `TERMINAL`，新认领为 `DENIED`
- `read_terminal(query: TerminalReceiptQuery) -> 上述观察 | StoreAbsent`：checkpoint 命名空间写入或仅暂存终态材料不会推进终态
- `register_question(*, claim, question) -> QuestionRegisterStatus`：`REGISTERED` / `ALREADY_REGISTERED` / `CONFLICT` / `STALE`（已 Stop 或终态，或认领不再当前）

测试夹具提供 `record_effect_evidence` / `record_consumption_receipt`（不是 #2205/#2206 端口）以及 `stage_checkpoint_material`。异步包装与 Host 端口同名。

## 测试

命令（工作目录为仓库根，解释器 Python 3.13，Asia/Shanghai；覆盖率在虚拟环境中运行）：

```sh
PYTHONPATH=.:temp/beebou/src python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/server/agent_service -t tests/server -p 'test_*.py'
<venv>/bin/python -m coverage run --source=server/agent_service/session_store -m unittest tests.server.agent_service.test_store_claim_authority tests.server.agent_service.test_store_foundation tests.server.agent_service.test_store_control_terminal
<venv>/bin/python -m coverage report -m --include='server/agent_service/session_store/claims.py,server/agent_service/session_store/observations.py,server/agent_service/session_store/kernel.py,server/agent_service/session_store/control.py'
python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --root . --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --format json
PYTHONPATH=tests/architecture python3 -B -m unittest tests.architecture.test_a02_enrollment.StoreEnrollmentTests.test_exact_checked_files_and_real_public_owner_are_clean
```

结果（在 `33893b063d6` 上复测，含 F8）：

- UT：434 tests, OK（PASS）。其中认领 + foundation + 控制 78 个（含终态 CAS、跨 Run 候选、共享 schema，以及 F8 旧 generation 回放回归）。既有 foundation、HostAPI、settings 与 Backend 测试均保持通过。
- 新增/改动的 owner-port 模块行覆盖率大于 90%：`control.py` 93%，`claims.py` 96%，`observations.py` 100%，`kernel.py` 99%。
- 架构扫描：0 findings，exit 0（PASS）
- `test_a02_enrollment` 精确文件集：PASS

2239.author: Jianyu010
2239.body:
Refs #2220

## What

- `server/agent_service/backend/host_api/endpoint.py`: `HostEndpoint`, the Host side of the Harness channel (H0, H2b, H4 to H8): hello and launch token, consumption gate, context read/commit/checkpoint, model calls, tool calls with plan reservation and reconciliation, questions, and the three completions.
- `server/agent_service/backend/host_api/hooks.py`: request transform hooks (AS-M6).
- `policy_contracts.py`: public `controlled_hook_scope`.
- Settings: `host.max_concurrent_model_calls`, `host.max_tool_argument_chars`, `host.tool_dispatch_seconds`.
- Ownership rows and package layout entries (AS-I7).

The hash-pinned files `operations.py`, `turn.py` and `blocking.py` are unchanged. Nothing constructs the endpoint yet; the deployed entry is unchanged.

## Carried from the old code (migration ledger rows 15, 16, 20, 24)

After the migration audit (#2229) these rules of the old Bee effect gate and tool bridge were ported:

- a tool call keeps one operation identity for every resend and recompute, and after a restart the stored plan is found by call id; a planned call is reconciled through lookup and never dispatched twice;
- planned calls of a Run are reconciled on attach and on detach;
- the supplement check, the hooks and the plan reservation run under one lock per Run, which `offer_supplement` also takes;
- argument size limit, single-operation tools, claim check before execution and before disclosing a result;
- the launch token is compared in constant time;
- a dispatch deadline; a deadline before the provider was entered settles as not executed and may be retried;
- a failed Store read is a retryable refusal and is never cached;
- the model reply is projected to role, content and tool calls.

## Open, recorded in the ledger

- Single-operation exclusivity is read-then-reserve, atomic only inside this process, until Session Store offers an exclusive reservation (requested on #2113). Per-Task exclusivity needs the same.
- Per-submission source binding is not in Plugin Gateway.
- A hook that answers Ask is a refusal; the approval path needs the P16 design.
- One dispatch deadline for all tools; the old per-action extensions are not carried.
- A hung provider blocks completion of its Run without bound.

The issue stays open for these and for the model relay.

## Review

An independent review of the first version found a double dispatch after a model call or an answered question, and a cached recovery failure. Both were reproduced, fixed, and are covered by `test_as_hostapi_identity.py`.

2240.author: Jianyu010
2240.body:
Refs #2222

## What

- `backend/service.py` `Backend`: the AS-M1 inbound provider (start, supplement, respond, interrupt, observe, stop, reconcile).
- `backend/run_coordinator.py`, `interaction.py`, `final.py`: one Run from claim and H1 to the committed terminal and published events.
- `backend/budget.py`: the Run time budget.
- `backend/ports.py`: what Backend needs from HostAPI, the process supervisor and the clock; `backend/host_binding.py` binds the real `HostEndpoint`.
- `[backend]` settings table; `host.max_hook_identity_chars`.
- Ownership rows and package layout entries (AS-I7).

Nothing constructs Backend yet; the deployed entry is unchanged.

## Carried from the old code (migration ledger rows 1, 2, 3, 5)

- The Run time budget is moved from the old `ExecutionBudget`: it pauses once per open question, resumes when each answer has been sent, and its expiry closes the gate, sends H3 and commits a stopped terminal that keeps the text produced so far.
- Stop, failure, budget expiry and shutdown reject the Run's open questions.
- A failed Run keeps its draft only after a transport failure or a lost process.
- The first Stop command wins; only a person's Stop is recorded as one.

## Moved or open, recorded in the ledger

- Moved to Session Manager admission (no Manager contract names them yet; listed on #2113): archived history, low-trust wait, parent-cancelled check, agent check, empty answer, Stop of a task tree, rerun block after a budget stop, recovery-card and uncertain-binding conditions of Stop confirmation.
- Needs a Session Store port: `reject_open_questions`. Until it exists the rejection does nothing in production.
- Open: reply reviews before publication, approval answers with the action hash, a per-Run record of time used, retry of a supervisor `release` that raised.

The issue stays open until the Store port exists and the joint tests of Phase 3 pass.

## Review

Two independent review rounds found 12 defects in total in the ported budget, Stop and terminal handling (for example a lost answer reply that left a Run without a time limit, and a raise during terminal submission that left a Run finalizing forever). All are fixed, each with a test that failed before the fix.

2241.author: Jianyu010
2241.body:
Refs #2219

## What

- `server/agent_service/backend/harness_supervisor/launcher.py` and `lifecycle.py`: `ProcessSupervisor`, the AS-M5 implementation of `HarnessSupervisor` (`acquire`, `release`, `kill`, `channel_available`, `subscribe_loss`, `reconcile`, `close`).
- `harness/channel.py`: closing the listener no longer waits on a connection that is still open.
- Settings: `supervisor.group_grace_seconds`, `group_poll_seconds`, `secret_env_names`.
- Ownership rows and package layout entries (AS-I7).

Nothing constructs the supervisor yet; the deployed entry is unchanged.

## Carried from the old code (migration ledger rows 7 to 9, 11, 16)

Ported from the old owned launcher (`workswarm_adapter.py`) and `workswarm_transport.py`:

- a new session and process group per child;
- a child environment that starts empty and receives only the names the launch specification declares, minus every name ending in `_TOKEN`, `_KEY`, `_SECRET` or `_PASSWORD` and the old fixed list of secret-bearing names, plus the channel socket path and a fresh launch token;
- a private socket directory and a private working directory per user or per Run;
- a ready timeout; a child that exits before hello is an error; a failed start stops the child;
- heartbeat with the missed-heartbeat rule; a lost process is reported once with its Run ids;
- stop: Shutdown, grace, SIGTERM to the group, wait, SIGKILL, check that the group is gone; all waits before the signals share one bound;
- an unconfirmed teardown blocks its key and is retried by every later acquire and at close.

New with the contract: per-user process reuse and per-Run processes, the Run limit capped by the descriptor, idle recycle, resource limits in the child.

## Differs from the old code, recorded in the ledger

- `release` and `kill` return released or unknown and do not raise.
- The old `API_KEY` exception in the child environment is dropped: a Harness reaches the model through the Host.
- The CPU limit applies only to per-Run processes, because the limit is cumulative over a process's life.
- Moved to `workswarm_compat.py` (not written yet): managed dotenv, model field checks, factory and history sockets, model readiness. Rows 7 to 9 stay partial until then.

## Review

An independent review reproduced four defects in the first version (a teardown that could hang before any signal, an idle recycle that ended a process that had just received a Run, per-Run processes never reconciled, a weaker secret filter) and found three more by reading. All are fixed with tests; nine of the eleven new review tests fail on the earlier version.

## Not verified

The address-space limit is applied on Linux only; these runs were on macOS, so it is checked as a plan, not in a real child.

| Check | Result |
| - | - |
| `unittest discover tests/server/agent_service` | 463 passed, including tests with a real child process; no child process left behind |
| Architecture scanner | no findings |

2242.author: Jianyu010
2242.body:
Refs #2220

## What

- `server/agent_service/backend/host_api/model_relay.py`: `ModelRelay`, a loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`POST /v1/chat/completions`) for a Harness that cannot call the Host over the channel. A request is authenticated by a per-Run credential and becomes one Host model call, so the selection check, hooks, concurrency limit and attempt evidence apply as on the channel. The Harness never holds a provider credential.
- `endpoint.py`: `models_call_single_use` (the same model operation without the resend cache), and `detach_run` now drops the detached Run's cached replies.
- `[model_relay]` settings: body and header limits, read, write and request deadlines, connection and per-Run request limits, stream event size, credential size.
- Package layout entry (AS-I7).

Nothing starts the relay yet; the deployed entry is unchanged.

## Carried from the old code (migration ledger rows 13 and 24)

- The child gets a resolved base address and one generated credential, loopback only (old launcher model environment).
- OpenAI wire shapes that the old client parses: reply body, error body and statuses, server-sent events with indexed tool-call fragments and `[DONE]`, each event below the old client's 256 KiB limit.
- A single choice with an assistant message is required.

## Decisions and open items, recorded in the ledger

- Built on the standard library stream server: the server package declares `aiohttp` only as the Model Gateway client extra. One request per connection; chunked bodies are refused.
- Streaming is cut from the finished message, not forwarded live (open point P11).
- Sampling parameters, `max_tokens` and `tool_choice` are accepted and dropped: the Host model call carries messages and tools only.
- A client disconnect, deadline or revocation does not cancel a model call already dispatched.
- Writing the child's model environment and waiting for model readiness belong to `workswarm_compat.py`.

## Review

An independent review confirmed that request smuggling is not possible, that authentication precedes the body read and that the run id always comes from the credential. It reproduced four defects (no load limits, writes without a deadline, an oversized stream event for a large tool call, an answer after revocation) and found an unbounded reply cache in the endpoint. All are fixed with tests.

## Not verified

No real WorkSwarm child or OpenAI client library was run against the relay (AS-T18 proper). The IPv6 bind is untested.

2245.body:
Refs #2219, Refs #2113

`server/agent_service/backend/harness_supervisor/workswarm_compat.py`: the temporary adapter of the design review. It is the Harness end of one channel inside the server process and maps the old `WorkSwarmAdapter` onto H0 to H9. The old adapter is injected (`LegacyWorkSwarm`), never imported and not copied; every old method is called with its old signature.

**Inert.** Nothing constructs it. The supervisor has no seam yet for a Harness that lives in the server process, and it has run only against a scripted fake of the old adapter, never against a real WorkSwarm child.

## What is mapped

- `stream` / `resume` → H1, H7, H7b + H2 answer, H4 + H8.
- `steer_witnessed` → H2 supplement with H2b; a supplement enters the candidate only after an OK `consumed`.
- `abort` → H3, then H8 `stopped` only when the runtime confirms the stop.
- `release_session` / `close_session` → end of every Run; an unreleased session blocks the next start until a retry confirms it.
- `status` / `stop` → H9.
- Model fields of the child environment point at the model relay; the per-Run relay credential is applied through the old `apply_model_configuration` and revoked at the end of the Run.

The migration ledger (rows 7 to 10 and 13, section "Rows 10 and 13") lists every old rule and its new line.

## Refused, because the design does not exist yet (P16)

A Run with prior context or media, the sealed / ACK path, checkpoint and settlement, a tool approval raised by the runtime.

## Open design points

Recorded as decision AS-I11: what the candidate of a WorkSwarm Run contains (its own tool messages never pass the Host), the per-Run credential against a long-lived child, question cards with several questions, option answers sent as text, the H2b safe point, the error mapping.

## Review

An independent review found six defects and five lesser ones (cancel during H8, the fake not modelling the old cancel path, credential not revoked on an early close, resent supplement and start, supplement in the candidate without a consumption fact). All are fixed, each with a test that failed first. Settings now reject a witness wait that does not end inside the consumption hold.

2246.author: Jianyu010
2246.body:
Refs #2219, Refs #2113

## Defect

`ProcessSupervisor.close()` waited with `while self._background: await asyncio.gather(*self._background)`. A finished background task stays in the set until its done callback runs, and `gather` over finished tasks completes without yielding to the loop. When `close()` resumed in the loop step right after a background task (a cancelled acquire's release, a loss report, a reconcile) finished, the callback never ran and the loop spun at full CPU. The whole event loop was stuck, not only the shutdown path.

It showed as an existing test (`test_cancelled_acquire_of_a_per_run_process_stops_the_child`) hanging in about 1 run in 100.

## Fix

`close()` awaits only the background tasks that have not finished. No new setting.

## Test

`CloseAfterBackgroundWorkTest.test_close_right_after_a_loss_report_finishes_returns` forces the interleaving with an event and bounds the scenario by wall clock; it fails on the old code and passes with the fix.

## Local gate (no CI runs on this base, decision AS-I6)

- Unit: 594 tests pass after merging the base.
- Ownership scanner: clean.
- 300 runs each of the three supervisor test files: no failure.
- Packaging proof not rerun: no file added, no public name changed.

2249.author: Jianyu010
2249.body:
Refs #2224, Refs #2113

A second independent review of the start/stop logic merged in #2247 found four defects. Each fix has a test that failed first.

1. **Relay left listening.** A stop that cancelled a start between the relay's bind and the assignment of its server object lost the server; stop skipped the relay step and reported "complete" with the socket still bound. `ModelRelay.start` now binds without serving, keeps the server, then serves, and closes the socket if the start is cancelled or fails. Stop and the failed-start cleanup always call `relay.stop()`. Tests check every loop turn of the start and that a connect to the address is refused.
2. **Stop report after a cancelled step.** A stop step that itself ended cancelled made the shared stop task end cancelled, so every concurrent and later `stop()` caller got `CancelledError` and nobody got the report. It is now that step's failure in the report; a cancellation is raised only when the stop itself is cancelled.
3. **Rejected publications.** A stored event that fails the Mobile event contract fails the same way every time, but was retried and used up a sequence number per attempt. `MobileEgress.publish` now raises the check's error before sending; `final` does not retry it and gives back the sequence number. The Run stays blocked and the Store keeps the row.
4. **Start still unwinding at the deadline.** It is now cancelled and tracked like the step tasks.

Decision AS-I12 and the migration ledger are updated. Open and recorded there: a rejected stored row blocks its Run on every start until the Store offers a way to quarantine it, and `publish_unpublished` reads one page.

## Local gate (no CI runs on this base, decision AS-I6)

- Unit: 670 tests pass after merging the base, three runs.
- Ownership scanner: clean.
- The four touched test files 20 runs without failure.

- 以上是本地验证。release 镜像构建和 ADX 集群实测见下节。

## 北京四 release 镜像端到端复测

2026-11-21 在北京四隔离命名空间 `adx-jiuwen-bj-golden-1117-01` 完成两个新测试身份的端到端复测。DigitalMate 镜像由 PR #2259 的 `91426bdf` 全量构建，ADX 组件由 `224285f1` 构建。发布模板 v29 后异步制备并回填同一版本，两个用户通过独立首次 Binding 恢复同一个 Golden `snapshot-c690354445c7e0616ac03d2d3470d1450286c67353804df16fd4fea95a3f0043`。

| 用户 2 | 未采集 | 1.471 s | 11.927 s | 7.847 s | 19.774 s |

两个目标均复用种子的 WorkSwarm/Bee PID `[9, 10]`，两路模型配置均得到确认。平台卷目录核对为不同 UID 的独占 SFS 目录。实际 Host 身份及 SQLite 文件各自独立，每个数据库只找到本用户本次会话输入。两个请求均有 Privacy renew/get 200 和 GLM-5.2 成功回执。

Closes #2260

## 改动

DigitalMate 在回复或报告产生后提交系统通知。沙箱使用工作负载身份请求 ADX，由 ADX 持有华为私钥、签名并转发。部署此功能需要配套的 ADX 推送入口。

- 客户端按登录账号注册设备。页面销毁和同账号重连保留华为 Push Kit 的账号绑定，退出登录、账号切换和明确撤权时执行解绑。
- 沙箱使用稳定事件 ID 和设备注册代次记录投递结果。只有明确未发送且可重试的结果才重试，避免在上游结果不确定时重复推送。
- Hive 回复和报告通知沿用现有业务提交入口。用户点击系统通知后，客户端在当前登录账号下打开对应内容。

## 验证

- 客户端相关自动化测试 476 项通过，覆盖页面销毁、显式注销、账号变更及解绑失败后的重试。
- Push Kit 服务端测试 12 项通过，覆盖 ADX 响应判定、身份恢复、幂等和重试。单元测试使用替身发送器或 HTTP 响应。
- HarmonyOS 模拟器在沙箱直连华为的对照环境完成离线验收。从最近任务上划移除后确认应用进程已退出，系统通知栏仍显示对应消息，点击后冷启动并打开该轮回复。
- 沙箱经 ADX 转发的测试环境此前已验证按 Home 后收到通知。最终 HAP 的 ADX 环境上划回归尚未单独确认。
- 提交人已在自己的物理手机上验证上划移除后的系统通知。真机连接的环境及 HAP 版本未记录。
- 迁移清单及组件登记检查通过。仓库级架构扫描仍有 3 项服务端已有报告，涉及 `hive_home_trial.py` 的适配层长度及两个 Hive 模块的依赖声明。这两个文件与发布基线相同。

## 审查状态

本 PR 汇总 DigitalMate 一侧的实现。请重点审查设备注册和撤销的授权边界、Bridge 的工作负载身份接线，以及结果未知时的投递语义。公开契约与设计审查待完成。

The checkpoint sequence race now opens both real SQLite capability instances before starting the two writes. With the original `67aa717dc`, a controlled schema reader holding a shared SQLite transaction could make the nonblocking writer return UNKNOWN; releasing that reader allowed one receipt and one CONFLICT. The revised test still requires exactly one receipt, one conflict, and an accepted successor. This is a test-only difference from `67aa717dc`.  - Windows and WSL Python 3.12: 63 focused checkpoint tests passed in each environment. WSL repeated the changed test 250 times with zero failures. - Clean WSL archive: 78 contract-package tests passed; Agent Service discovery ran 1056 tests with six existing expected failures. Candidate architecture check reported zero violations and three existing file-size warnings. - Hosted CI and deployed integration were not run. Independent review of this exact head, the v1 design decision, F5 and F8 remain pending.   - **Current head 5ace96c85ae3182577bf62ba90e5390eb2c4ff81 on integration fb5925d49.** Checkpoint verification now runs outside the Store writer lock. Store rechecks its principal and Run fences under the lock. The new regression holds the verifier and proves Stop for another principal and for the original Run both commit while verification is pending. The original late checkpoint returns CLOSED and creates no receipt. A second regression documents the file-wide quota: another principal's same raw key cannot read the first principal's record, even when the shared ceiling rejects its new write. Production verifier binding and external revocation ordering remain pending. - Windows Python 3.12 and WSL exact export each passed 58 checkpoint tests. The WSL Agent Service suite ran 966 tests, with six expected failures from #2304 and one failure at the unchanged Harness channel fixed-time concurrent test. Candidate-policy architecture scan reported zero findings. The full suite repeated the same Harness failure and that test passed in isolation. Before the fix, the new regression on 3bbb6d22 timed out waiting for unrelated Stop while the verifier held the Store lock. The exact candidate passed 78/78 contract-package tests on WSL. The trusted integration architecture policy reports four AR10 findings for the new Delivery and checkpoint owner paths. Owner registration remains pending. Windows Python 3.12 also passed all 35 selected A14 accounting-contract and enrollment tests on this head.  - Historical head `5031655447aad5d57c0092720c69f9f36c7ab388` uses a query-only SQLite transaction for checkpoint receipt reads. Before the fix a second connection holding BEGIN IMMEDIATE forced an existing receipt to return UNKNOWN; the regression now passes and revoked read authority still returns CLOSED. Windows: 33 checkpoint/schema tests PASS. Exact clean WSL tree: 891 Agent Service tests PASS. Prior head c59693c07 passed 77 contract-package tests; that gate was not rerun for this read-only update. - The concrete checkpoint owner API differs from the PROPOSED #2183 `HostSessionStoreProvider` shape; the adaptation / contract precedence and Stop-reconciliation boundary are under discussion at https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/2113#issuecomment-7060464603. No owner agreement or production cutover is asserted.  - On `cd6213b218366abfecea42fc4d7bcda355e3ef3e`, WSL Ubuntu Python 3.12.3: checkpoint codec, recovery and local system suites, 42 tests PASS. Includes explicit null vs missing timestamp and retained single-message offload vectors. - Windows Python 3.12: the timeout/reconciliation local system test intermittently fails; the unchanged `757e4dd3b2991c481f1d64baf24d57b219eda959` baseline reproduced the same failure. Not treated as a passing gate. - Complete Agent Service suite on WSL Ubuntu Python 3.12.3: exact candidate archived to the local Linux filesystem, 794 PASS in 14.769s (`logs/2262-full-linux.log`, local workspace). Earlier runs from the mounted Windows filesystem were 789/794 and 790/794, with Harness/Host/start-stop timing failures; those failures are retained as environment-specific observations, not asserted baseline-identical or deleted. Windows timeout test also failed on unchanged baseline as described above. - Authentic design acceptance, F8 scope decision, independent review at this new head, production authentication and deployed integration remain pending. Native component-branch CI is not a passing check.  - Checkpoint timeout regression at `ae8139c1afef5ce627e73d5534033caad626f314` (integration base `82cd4a3df`). The previous head `5d5022bc0` reproduced a second `UNKNOWN` on Windows when the test reused the 10 ms simulated deadline for a file-backed SQLite reconciliation. The tests now hold and release the actual writer explicitly, assert the original write persisted before retry, and compare the original and replayed receipts. The writer unit test also verifies that retry and caller cancellation did not schedule a second write while the original was pending. The test change has no production code diff. Windows Python 3.12: 54 checkpoint tests passed and both affected cases passed 20 runs each. WSL Linux, exact Git archive: the same 54 tests passed. Test participants include the real HostEndpoint and file-backed checkpoint Store, with the existing binding/verifier and Gateway substitutes. Live deployment and F8 retention/cutover acceptance remain outstanding.  **Current head `c479f8adc`** on component `596432a42`. If the retained envelope or material checksums fail, a different requested digest yields UNKNOWN. An intact retained record with a changed intent still yields CONFLICT. Existing checkpoint format is unchanged. Capabilities reopening an enabled exact v3 file validate it in a read transaction ordered with local checkpoints. An initial valid v2 activation still uses the existing schema writer; unexpected schema is rejected.  Windows and exact WSL export passed 60 focused checkpoint tests. This evidence is for the separate combined branch on locally selected experimental schema v19. Its Host cutoff, pre-fence verification and retention authorization are controlled test inputs. The two PR-head checks above remain scoped to their quoted revisions. Production Host wiring, a design verdict on the scope/ownership of F5 and F8, the applicable schema ADR, independent exact-PR-head review and merged integration remain pending.  **Self-checklist**:  - [ ] **Design**: Maintainer review and all review comments completed. - [ ] **Test**: UT/ST coverage and required scenarios completed. - [ ] **Verification**: Complete, current-head verification and expected outcomes recorded. - [ ] **Interface**: Applicable interface approvals completed. - [ ] **Document**: Applicable official documentation assessed.  ---  The original author description and historical test results below are retained for provenance. Its head, test counts and trace refer to the prior candidate `757e4dd3b2991c481f1d64baf24d57b219eda959`; they are not current-head passes. Store rechecks the captured catalog revision after building a read page, and before returning a definite mark status or committing a mark. ## 改动

DigitalMate 在回复或报告产生后提交系统通知。沙箱使用工作负载身份请求 ADX，由 ADX 持有华为私钥、签名并转发。部署此功能需要配套的 ADX 推送入口。

- 客户端按登录账号注册设备。页面销毁和同账号重连保留华为 Push Kit 的账号绑定，退出登录、账号切换和明确撤权时执行解绑。
- 沙箱使用稳定事件 ID 和设备注册代次记录投递结果。只有明确未发送且可重试的结果才重试，避免在上游结果不确定时重复推送。
- Hive 回复和报告通知沿用现有业务提交入口。用户点击系统通知后，客户端在当前登录账号下打开对应内容。

## 验证

- 客户端相关自动化测试 476 项通过，覆盖页面销毁、显式注销、账号变更及解绑失败后的重试。
- Push Kit 服务端测试 12 项通过，覆盖 ADX 响应判定、身份恢复、幂等和重试。单元测试使用替身发送器或 HTTP 响应。
- HarmonyOS 模拟器在沙箱直连华为的对照环境完成离线验收。从最近任务上划移除后确认应用进程已退出，系统通知栏仍显示对应消息，点击后冷启动并打开该轮回复。
- 沙箱经 ADX 转发的测试环境此前已验证按 Home 后收到通知。最终 HAP 的 ADX 环境上划回归尚未单独确认。
- 提交人已在自己的物理手机上验证上划移除后的系统通知。真机连接的环境及 HAP 版本未记录。
- 迁移清单及组件登记检查通过。仓库级架构扫描仍有 3 项服务端已有报告，涉及 `hive_home_trial.py` 的适配层长度及两个 Hive 模块的依赖声明。这两个文件与发布基线相同。

## 审查状态

本 PR 汇总 DigitalMate 一侧的实现。请重点审查设备注册和撤销的授权边界、Bridge 的工作负载身份接线，以及结果未知时的投递语义。公开契约与设计审查待完成。

## Scope

Extends the existing Nightly-only PR #2276 for `release_v0.1.13`. The original change removes Bench from the Nightly workflow. This update makes each E2E run build the signed HarmonyOS app from the same `SOURCE_SHA` as the deployed backend image, preserves the existing account cache through a verified in-place install, and reports login-cache versus UI-automation failures separately.

- Require Nightly signing secrets and a valid debug profile with the expected bundle and calendar ACLs; warn when the profile expires within 30 days.
- Inspect the candidate signed HAP and the installed app before install. A bundle, signer, or downgrade mismatch stops before `install -r`; after install, verify the installed bundle, version and signer.
- Confirm the existing login cache returns to the conversation page before running any case. Do not reboot the device or clear app data on preflight failure.
- Keep E2E gated on successful deployment of the same source commit. Remove obsolete `skip_app` behavior and stale `skip_image=true` E2E dispatch examples.
- Correct the remaining Nightly/Bench documentation and add a structural workflow assertion.

The Nightly run before this fix, [44882941508](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44882941508), deployed its backend image and installed its app, then failed the old generic UI preflight. It executed **0 E2E cases**. Its logs do not distinguish an unrestored login cache from UITest/layout or file-transfer failure. That run is baseline evidence only; it does not verify this change.

2286.author: BESTTOOLBOX
2286.body:
## What this fixes

The nightly ST job (`.github/workflows/nightly.yml` → `node tests/st/run-isolated.mjs`) runs **one case per invocation** and requires the native report to contain **exactly that one row** (`tests/st/run-isolated.mjs`). `selectScenes` in `tests/st/scenes.mjs` resolved a scene key and a result-row name through the same lookup and then returned the whole row set either way.

Consequence on nightly run [44882941508](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44882941508) (ST job `136810198888`, head `e319c05a`): all 13 batches printed `ST passed` — **no case failed on the device** — but the `cases=` sequence was `1,1,1,1,1,2,2,1,1,1,1,1,1`. Batches 6 and 7 are `real_model_structured_choice` and `real_model_structured_choice_home`, the main and branch rows of the same scene. Each reported **two** rows, so the strict length check rejected them and recorded `Native case report selection mismatch` → `blocked`. Verdict `11 passed / 2 blocked / 0 failed` → job red.

That row was also executed on the device twice (127 s + 58 s of the batch budget spent re-running a case that had already passed).

## Change

- `tests/st/scenes.mjs` — a **scene key** (`choice`) selects the whole row, branches included (unchanged); a **result-row name** (`real_model_structured_choice_home`) now selects exactly that one row; an unknown token still throws `Unknown ST case`.
- `tests/st/run-isolated.mjs` — the selection is checked **before** the device run, so a name that cannot produce a one-row report fails fast with an actionable message instead of after the run with a bare mismatch. **The `report.cases?.length!==1` check is untouched**; nothing was weakened.
- `tests/unit/digitalmate-device-st.test.mjs` — new invariants: every automatic-suite row selects itself, every branched scene key still selects the whole row, every branch name selects itself.
- `tests/st/README.md` — documents the key/row-name distinction and the isolated runner's one-row requirement.
- `.github/workflows/nightly.yml` — drop the retired `'optional'` suite from the live-wire matrix. PRO-01 was deleted together with its `COMPATIBILITY_SUITES` entry, but nightly kept invoking it; `run.mjs` answers an unknown suite with a usage error, so the live-wire job failed on `identity, optional, artifact` — `optional` for a case that no longer exists. Only that one token was removed; the other six entries are untouched.
- `tests/unit/ci-gate.test.mjs` — new read-only invariant: every suite named in `nightly.yml` must still exist in `LIVE_WIRE_SUITES`.

## Verification

Same layer as the nightly (`prepare.mjs --compile-only`), before vs after:

| selection | before (`e319c05a`) | after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `real_model_structured_choice` | `cases=2` | `cases=1` |
| `real_model_structured_choice_home` | `cases=2` | `cases=1` |
| `choice` (scene key, whole row kept) | `cases=2` | `cases=2` |

- All 13 automatic-suite rows now select exactly themselves; `selectScenes('all')` still returns 13; unknown/duplicate selections still throw.
- The new workflow invariant was negative-tested: putting `'optional'` back makes it fail with `nightly runs unknown live-wire suite: optional`, removing it passes.
- `bash scripts/ci/node-ut.sh`: **4504 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped**, `coverage-gate: OK line coverage 78.9% >= 55%`.
- No `.ets`, no product code and no assertion was touched.

## Not claimed

The nightly has **not** been re-run with this branch, so this does not claim the nightly is green. The two remaining live-wire outcomes are device-side and unrelated to this fix: `identity` (PRO-02, the device case itself failed) and `artifact` (ART-01, device did not fail but the evidence checks were not satisfied → `blocked`). The artifacts of the run above could not be uploaded (`Artifact storage quota has been hit`), so per-check details are only available from the console log.

`docs/UPDATES.md` records the full root-cause write-up.

**What does this PR do / why do we need it**:

On `component/agent-service`, two Store control ports sharing one kernel can both miss the terminal idempotency record and then race. One port commits the terminal, while the other can return `STALE` for the same request. A receipt lookup can also return the original committed receipt for a different candidate that reuses the same operation ID.

Use the Store kernel transaction to cover the idempotency check, terminal state write and receipt recording. Receipt lookup compares the frozen request to the recorded intent. The same request returns the original receipt, while a changed request returns `CONFLICT`. This follows the [existing receipt lookup contract](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2891252dd881a30c7adffe69d4e7a3cd43bb53c9/docs/implementations/contracts/server-agent-service-session-store-owner-ports-target.md#L553). The fix uses the current publication writer and receipt format and does not depend on the replay work in #2263.

**Which issue(s) this PR fixes**:

Refs #2203
Refs #2197
Refs #2113

**What scenarios were tested, and what were the verification results（Function, performance, reliability, etc.）**：

- Baseline `2891252dd881a30c7adffe69d4e7a3cd43bb53c9` reproduced both regressions. The two-port retry returned `STALE` from one port, and a read with a changed candidate returned `TerminalCommitted`.
- Candidate `95e04a42b630c2e99729687c540fd34374ffaf89` passed 35 Store control/terminal tests on Windows Python 3.12. The concurrent retry returned the same original receipt from both ports with one publication, the changed candidate read returned `CONFLICT`, and the original receipt stayed readable.
- The exact candidate archive passed all 842 Agent Service tests in WSL Ubuntu Python 3.12. Tests use actual Store ports, one shared in-memory Store kernel and test Run claims. The same archive passed 77 contract package tests in WSL, and the two-port regression passed 25 repetitions in Windows. Hosted CI, disk restart and deployed ST were not run.

2291.author: BESTTOOLBOX
2291.body:
## What this fixes

Two live-wire ST cases were red in nightly run [44882941508](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/44882941508) (job `136816799496`): `identity` **failed** and `artifact` **blocked**. Both turned out to be the case reading a value that arrives asynchronously, before it had arrived — not a product defect. Both are fixed on the case side only; no product code, no assertion text and no gate threshold is changed.

### ART-01 `artifact_receipt_required` → `artifact` suite (was `blocked`)

The wait polled the artifact projection but never asked the client to sync it. Under `ST_HIVE_HOME=true` the projection is built from `latestSnapshot.hive_artifacts`, which only advances on a client sync, so the loop re-read its own stale copy for the whole window.

Measured before the fix: `waitedMs=300090`, and `540231` with the window temporarily raised to 540 s, at `visibleArtifacts=0` / `claimSource=projection`, while the independent origin read (`direct-origin.json`) already carried `ST-1795261852037-f6dce1-ART01-control.pdf` — 1400 B, active, `contentVerified:true`. Raising the window changed nothing, which is what rules out "slow" and points at "stale".

Fix: `await runtime.refresh()` before each read inside `waitForOwnedArtifact`. This is the pattern this repository already relies on in `LiveBusiness.test.ets` (`waitForArtifactName` re-reads every poll; its comment records that reading the list once "raced … a delivery that was still in flight"). The predicate is untouched: still this turn's exact run-scoped file name, and a turn that publishes no file still ends `BLOCK`.

### PRO-02 `protocol_invalid_task_identity` → `identity` suite (was `failed`)

`[ASSERT_MISMATCH] The Bee terminal is missing or does not carry the marker the delegated turn was asked to produce: beeTerminalChars=0`, after 51 s on CI and 19 s locally. Two separate causes:

1. **The capture was gated on a lane that binds later.** `beeTerminalText` was only assigned inside `if (hive)`, but `hive` binds only once the dispatch row appears. A turn that settled before that binding delivered its final `digitalmate.task.text` with nothing capturing it — which is also why the case passed whenever the turn happened to settle slowly (~333 s). It is captured unconditionally now; the lane is still told only when it is bound.
2. **The assertion sampled once instead of waiting.** On one tree, two back-to-back runs disagreed: 122 characters → pass, and a sample at 18.9 s → 0. The Home turn settles at ~7.6 s while the Bee terminal arrives near ~20 s. The case now waits for the terminal on its own dispatch budget, then asserts the identical predicate. A turn that never delivers a terminal still fails the same assertion, now carrying `waitedForTerminal=false`.

## Evidence

Local reproduction of the CI environment (same upstream endpoint, `ST_HIVE_HOME=true`, `ST_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS=600000` — which is also CI's effective value, since repo variable `ST_CASE_TIMEOUT_MS` is unset), two consecutive runs per suite:

| suite | case | coverage | run 1 | run 2 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact` | `artifact_receipt_required` | ART-01 | passed, 306 887 ms | passed, 315 647 ms |
| `identity` | `protocol_invalid_task_identity` | PRO-02 | passed, 30 040 ms | passed, 34 140 ms |

All four runs recorded byte-identical test sources (`ArtifactLive.test.ets` `9fdfd331…`, `IdentityLive.test.ets` `6f1f9a02…` in every `source-manifest.json`), so this is 2-of-2 on one tree, not two different trees. All four report `wire-assessment.status=passed`, `issues=[]`, `nativeExitCode=0`.

Artifact branches in the passing runs — 10/10: control PDF read back (`%PDF-` header, EOF, 1 page, marker text), `no-receipt` absence window (`visibleArtifacts=0`), `invalid-id` (`FILE_FAILED`), `unreadable` (`INCOMPLETE_DOWNLOAD`), the four restore reads (`contentVerified=true`, no duplicates) and the restore inventory (`artifacts=4`).

Identity in the passing runs: the turn streamed 9 frames (8 malformed/foreign `task_id` variants plus the live canonical control) yielding 10 delta verdicts with `acceptedByProduct=0` — the gate refused every one, with no exception, no extra bubble and no draft-state change. The B turn stayed with exactly one user and one reply row and byte-identical text, the projected Home reply equalled the independent cloud reply by SHA-256, and the normal C follow-up completed.

## What is not claimed here

The GitHub nightly has **not** confirmed these two suites yet. `workflow_dispatch` cannot select individual live-wire suites: `$suites` is hardcoded in `.github/workflows/nightly.yml:471`, and `digitalmate-st-live-wire` declares `needs: [digitalmate-st]` with an `if` that rejects `skipped`, while `digitalmate-st` itself requires the image job. So any dispatch reaching the live-wire job also pays for the image build and the full ST batch.

A full `Nightly` dispatch (`run 44904759220`, head `193beab1`, all defaults) was started on this branch and is the remaining confirmation; its live-wire job is what will decide whether these two suites are stable on CI. No workflow file is modified by this PR.

## Test plan

- [x] `artifact` suite: two consecutive local runs on this tree, `issues: []`, exit 0
- [x] `identity` suite: two consecutive local runs on this tree, `issues: []`, exit 0
- [ ] GitHub nightly live-wire job (running: run 44904759220)

Concurrent retries recover the first committed admission. Inbox retains its receipt-only behavior. Backend launch is a separate step.
